RULES (the measurable half of the guide)
- Reading level: write at grade 5 or below (on-brand median 3.5; ceiling is the median plus 1, an engine rule).
- Sentences: average about 11 words; keep the longest under 21 (2x the average, an engine rule).
- Address the reader as "you" (5.5 per 100 words on-brand).
- Contractions: use them (4.5 per 100 words on-brand).
- Exclamation marks: none.
- Hedges (very, really, just, perhaps...): on-brand runs at 0.8 per 100 words; keep new copy at or below that.
- Words to avoid: synergy, leverage, robust, seamless, cutting-edge, best-in-class, world-class, revolutionary, game-changing, unleash, supercharge, streamline.
